name: ProgressBar
summary: A labelled bar that shows how far a task has come, or that it runs with no known end.
useWhen: A task that reports how far it is: an upload, an export, an import
A task with no known end that takes more than a few seconds and has a name, as the indeterminate form
A list of tasks, one small bar per row
avoidWhen: A measured value that is not a task, such as storage used or a score
A short wait on a small area with no value
Little room, such as a card corner or a file chip
Steps the person moves through, such as a form wizard

value.description: Progress from 0 to max. null or undefined gives the indeterminate form. Values out of range are clamped.

max.description: The value that means done. The minimum is always 0 (Radix Progress).

label.description: Visible text that names the task and labels the progressbar through aria-labelledby. Without it, pass aria-label.

showValue.description: Shows the value text at the end of the label row: the percent, or the loading words while indeterminate.

valueText.description: (value, max) => string. Builds both the visible value and aria-valuetext, for example 3 of 10 files. Default: a whole percent in the page language with Western digits.

loadingLabel.description: What the value and aria-valuetext say while indeterminate. Arabic default under lang ar: جار التحميل.

size.description: Track thickness 4, 8 and 12 px (space.fixed.2xs, m, xl); the text steps from font.size.xs to m.

tone.description: Indicator color. accent is color.primary.on-surface; the others are color.state.<tone>.solid.

a11y.role: progressbar (Radix Progress) with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext
a11y.announce: Not a live region: a screen reader reads the label and the value text when it reaches the bar. aria-valuetext carries the formatted value, or the loading words while indeterminate. To announce a finish, say it once in a Toast or a status line.
notes: The label and the value sit inside the progressbar; its children are presentational, so the label names it through aria-labelledby and the value through aria-valuetext.
Indeterminate slides a 40% segment along the track. Under reduced motion it stops as a full, faded track and the value text says Loading.
The indicator scales from the inline start: it fills from the right in Arabic.
Under forced colors the track has a CanvasText border and the indicator is Highlight.
Tone is never the only signal: the label says what happened (Upload stopped) and the value says how far.
WCAG 2.2.2: the indeterminate loop has no pause control; a busy indicator is essential motion, and it stops under reduced motion.
The percent is rounded down, so an unfinished task never shows 100%.
With showValue false, the stopped indeterminate bar under reduced motion has no visible Loading text; keep showValue on, or say the state in text next to the bar.

en.label: Name the task as a present participle plus a noun: Uploading files, Exporting board. On a stop, say what happened and what to do next.
en.value: A whole percent by default. Count units when they mean more: 3 of 10 files.
en.loading: Loading by default; a more exact verb when known: Preparing export.

ar.label: Noun form labels, no diacritics: رفع الملفات، تصدير اللوحة.

react.note: Value changes ease the scaleX transform over duration.slow. The indeterminate loop is named after the spinner pattern of the 1.11 catalog (the looping busy form) until the catalog has a bar form. Values are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat and Western digits in a private helper (format.ts) until packages/shared/src/number.ts lands.

styles.studio: A pill track in overlay 10; the accent indicator is the strongest text color (near white on dark, near black on light), as Studio has a neutral primary.
styles.desk: The same track; the accent indicator is yellow on dark and dark gold on light.
styles.neutral: Planned: the brand color for accent.
styles.liquid: Planned: a solid track; the bar is content, never glass.

mistakes.right: A Meter: storage is a measure, not a task

mistakes.wrong: Only the danger color when an upload fails
mistakes.right: tone danger and a label that says Upload stopped and what to do next

mistakes.wrong: A bar that jumps back to 0 between steps of one task
mistakes.right: One bar for the whole task, or count units with valueText

mistakes.wrong: A bar with no label and no aria-label
mistakes.right: A visible label that names the task, or aria-label when the context names it
